context:
Goal: the Hand end-of-day pile and "Not normal today" land, which the restore-stamp change and the live Worker deploy wait on.
Problem (goal): the pile lists an envelope when its count is above 0 and its stamp is today, but a same-day "One fewer" on a copy checked in yesterday also stamps it today, so it shows with no check-in today, and the saved data cannot tell a check-in from a decrement, so only you can say what the pile means.
Based on (ruling): the rule that the saved data's layout never changes, which rules out a new saved field; the Hand end-of-day answer you gave on 2026-11-19 23:23 CST covers only the count-0 un-check.
Based on (read): the Hand end-of-day change is PR 390; the coordinator found this in review.
Departs from: main has no end-of-day pile on the Hand screen — this adds one that can list an envelope touched today by a decrement.
Waiting on: your answer; PR 390 waits on this point, and the coordinator fixes its other review findings meanwhile.

options.gain: Nothing new is saved, and it ships now.
options.how: The screen text says touched today; the coordinator records the same-day decrement as accepted in the Hand rules.
options.label: The pile means "touched today", and the screen says so
options.lose: An envelope can appear with no new check-in today, and the wording differs from the mockup.

options.gain: The wording stays as the mockup drew it.
options.how: The coordinator files a known-gap record for the decrement case and PR 390 ships with the mockup wording.
options.label: Keep the wording "checked in today" and record the false entry as a known gap
options.lose: The screen can say something untrue about an envelope.

short: Hand pile: "touched today" or keep "checked in today"

shown.label: The pile means "touched today", and the screen says so
Keep the wording "checked in today" and record the false entry as a known gap

title: Should the Hand end-of-day pile mean "touched today", or keep the wording "checked in today"?
why: A stamp on each check-in would be exact but breaks the saved data's fixed layout, so it is not offered; a is the coordinator's recommendation.
